verdict.rationale: Ironclad's own webhooks let users register events that automatically trigger an outbound POST to a URL, created and managed in the UI or via API. That is a narrow, first-party form of event-triggered action. Workflow Designer exists, but the evidence never describes in-product rules, conditions, or native triggered actions; richer automation such as auto-blocking or advancing approvals requires building external integrations. Missing for 10: documented in-product rule/condition builder, native actions beyond webhook POST (e.g., auto-routing, approvals, notifications), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
